summary.text: Jacob Ashby is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 43 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ashby is an occupational therapist and U.S. Army veteran who served in the State Assembly from 2018 to 2023; he is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Jacob Ashby lives in Castleton, New York, and served in the U.S. Army from 2006 to 2014 as a civil affairs officer and in the U.S. Army Reserve.
He earned an A.A. from Hudson Valley Community College in 2000, a B.S. in occupational therapy from Keuka College in 2002, and an M.B.A. from Clarkson University in 2015.

His career includes work as an occupational therapist with Sunnyview Rehabilitation Hospital, St. Vincent Healthcare and Albany County Nursing Home, and he opened and operated Ashby Adaptive Occupational Therapy.
Ashby served as a Rensselaer County legislator and then represented Assembly District 107 from 2018 to 2023, succeeding Steven McLaughlin (R).
He has represented Senate District 43 since 2023, succeeding Daphne Jordan (R).

In the 2025-2026 session he is ranking member of the Senate Aging Committee and the Veterans, Homeland Security and Military Affairs Committee, and is also assigned to the Health, Disabilities and Insurance committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Ashby faces Devin Lander (D / Working Families Party).
